Direction reversal: when Direct=FalshDirect (against signal), Up/Dn buffers are swapped so indicator downtrend signals trigger buys and uptrend signals trigger sells

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MM input is share of deposit (0.1=10%). MMMode selects calculation method: FREEMARGIN uses free margin, BALANCE uses account balance, LOSSFREEMARGIN uses loss share of free margin, LOSSBALANCE uses loss share of balance, LOT uses fixed lot size. Default is LOT mode.

custom_logic_notes: The Direct enum flips the interpretation of indicator buffers: TrueDirect uses buffer 0 for UpTrend and buffer 1 for DnTrend (normal), while FalshDirect swaps them (buffers 1->UpTrend, 0->DnTrend) effectively trading against the indicator signal. Signal time is calculated as SERIES_LASTBAR_DATE + TimeShiftSec for expiry-based position opening. The Recount flag ensures signal recalculation on failure. BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/BuyPosClose/SellPosClose boolean inputs act as permission gates for each trade direction and action.
python_conversion_notes: Requires recreation of the VolatilityPivot custom indicator (4 buffers: UpTrend, DnTrend, UpSignal, DnSignal) which internally uses ATR and MA calculations. The TradeAlgorithms.mqh library provides BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose, GlobalVariableDel_, and LoadHistory functions - all must be reimplemented. The Direct enum reverses buffer mapping which must be preserved. Signal time tracking (UpSignalTime/DnSignalTime) appears to be used as expiry for pending-style opens within the TradeAlgorithms framework. The CIsNewBar class for new bar detection also comes from TradeAlgorithms.mqh. SL/TP are in points (not pips) so no digit adjustment needed, but pip-to-point conversion may be needed for Python if using pip-based frameworks.
